summary: Verified redesigned DashboardInsights charts (burn-rate-chart + anomaly-timeline) on web as Cathy. Both charts render the required headline figures, legends, month-word+year x-axis labels (no raw date fragments), value labels, and plain-English footer summaries. Bar keyboard/click navigation to /app/statements/{id} works. No JS errors from the redesigned components. Success criteria all met.

issues: Duplicate month labels (e.g. two 'Aug '26' bars) appear when multiple statements sit in the same month. Not a bug — data-driven — but consider disambiguating (e.g. 'Aug '26 (2)') in a follow-up.

critical_code_review_comments: SpendingChart+ChecksChart use hardcoded hex palette (C.funded/copay/attention/watch/ok) which is theme-agnostic; text (text-primary-k, text-muted-k) uses tokens and stays legible on bg-surface-2 in both themes.
monthYearLabel handles month-word, DD/MM/YYYY (AU), and ISO uploaded_at fallbacks — verified live output produces only 'Mon 'YY' labels (no raw '01/08/' fragments).
Bars are keyboardable (role=button, tabIndex, Enter/Space handler) and clickable — verified navigation to /app/statements/{id}.
Verified findings on live preview against Cathy/Dorothy (6 burn bars, 8 anomaly bars, 5 alerts, $3,496 total).
context_for_next_testing_agent: DashboardInsights redesign validated iter316. burn-rate-chart shows 'What you pay vs what's funded' with total billed headline + legend + value-label bars + summary sentence. anomaly-timeline shows 'N statements reviewed' + 'N need your attention' (terracotta) or checks-all-clear pill + legend (Needs attention/Worth a look/Just so you know) + stacked bars + summary. Month labels are 'Mon 'YY' (e.g. Aug '26). Clicking bar with id navigates to /app/statements/{id}.
